```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
```

Read ata

```{r}
data = read.csv("ny_pollution.csv.gz")
data$date = as.Date(data$date)
```

Aggregate deaths by week to match pollution records

```{r}
weekly_data <- data %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  fill(pollution, .direction = "down") %>%
  mutate(week_start = floor_date(date, "week", week_start = 1)) %>%
  group_by(week_start) %>%
  summarise(
    death = sum(death, na.rm = TRUE),
    pollution = first(pollution)
  )
```

Plot correlation between deaths and pollution on a weekly scale

```{r}
cor(weekly_data$death, weekly_data$pollution, use = "complete.obs")

lm = lm(weekly_data$death ~ weekly_data$pollution)
plot(weekly_data$pollution, weekly_data$death, pch = 16, cex = 0.5)
abline(lm)
```
